name: Andorra
description: Andorra, a small country in the Pyrenees ruled by two co-princes, from the Paréage of 1278 to its constitution of 1993 and today.

checkpoints.name: The Paréage
checkpoints.note: The Paréage of 1278 split rule over the valleys between a bishop and a count, an arrangement that still holds.

checkpoints.name: The valleys
checkpoints.note: The Council of the Land met from 1419. The valleys lived from farming and later from trade and tourism.

checkpoints.name: Modern Andorra
checkpoints.note: The constitution of 1993 made Andorra a modern state, and it joined the United Nations the same year.
